newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize firm on export demand.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize firm on export demand.

text.p: Argentine cash maize firmed in good volume trade midsession at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange with exporters buying heartily to load ships in port, traders said.

Prices paid to farmers for maize in Bahia Blanca rose $1 to $113. May soybeans slipped after lower nearby soy prices in Chicago, losing $5 to $290 in slow trade. May sunflower seed firmed $2 to $220 in good volume trade. Crush margins have improved and sunseed might have risen higher if not for lower soybeans. Spot wheat rose $3 on the cash market to $156 in Buenos Aires, helped by international price rises.
